sources.title: mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multilingual-nli-2mil7: Text-to-Text model ...
sources.snippet: Q: How does this model compare to mDeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-xnli for multilingual tasks? A: The current model adds the multilingual-NLI-26lang-2mil7 dataset (2.7M pairs in 27 languages) to the English MNLI and XNLI training, resulting in significantly better cross-lingual performance and support for non-English zero-shot classification.

sources.title: GitHub - jorguzb/mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multilingual-nli-2mil7
sources.snippet: The underlying mDeBERTa-v3-base model was pre-trained by Microsoft on the CC100 multilingual dataset with 100 languages. The model was then fine-tuned on the XNLI dataset and on the multilingual-NLI-26lang-2mil7 dataset. Both datasets contain more than 2.7 million hypothesis-premise pairs in 27 languages spoken by more than 4 billion people.

sources.snippet: mDeBERTa-v3 is a multilingual text classification model supporting dozens of languages including German, French, and Chinese. It excels in Natural Language Inference (NLI) and fact-checking tasks with moderate parameters and fast inference, making it ideal for multilingual content moderation, sentiment analysis, and document classification.
